# Bundled platform adapters

`douk_downloader/` contains the source adapter from [DouK-Downloader](https://github.com/JoeanAmier/TikTokDownloader), and `ks_downloader/` contains the source adapter from [KS-Downloader](https://github.com/JoeanAmier/KS-Downloader). Both upstream projects are GPL-3.0; their license files are kept beside the copied source. The main application imports only the link/detail parsing pieces needed to normalize a reference video.
